name: five-teams
description: Hypothetical, not a forecast: Relay has grown to five product teams of about eight engineers, triage has its own team and on-call rota, and the company runs a shared identity service, a shared rate-limit store and a platform team that operates the broker.

titles.CON-1: Operable by five product teams, each with its own on-call rota
titles.CON-2: Each team ships its own changes on the daily deploy train
titles.CON-6: Triage capacity can grow without growing the rest of Relay (triage now has its own team)

CON-1: One artifact and one rota shared by five teams; every incident pages people who did not write the code.
CON-2: Five teams' changes queue for one artifact on one train.

CON-1: Each team owns and runs its own services on its own rota.
CON-2: Each team deploys its own services independently, on its own schedule.
ESC-N03: The shared identity service checks permissions for every service.
ESC-N04: The shared rate-limit store holds the count across all rules.
ESC-N10: The platform team runs the broker as shared infrastructure, not a paid service.

CON-1: The triage team runs triage-svc on its own rota; the rest stays one artifact.
CON-2: Triage deploys on its own; the monolith's teams share one artifact less often.
